deadlines.dateText: Due to our rolling admission process, you may apply at any time for the next programme start. Applications can be submitted after 1 December for the following year. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis until we have selected the optimum cohort of 25 students. Since there is only a limited number of places available, we strongly encourage you to apply as early as possible (before 1 May). Applicants from non-European countries should bear in mind that the visa application might take several months.
